package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type PracticeExecutionReader interface {
	ReadExecutionProjection(context.Context, string, string) (domain.PracticeExecutionProjection, error)
}
type NextActionResolver struct {
	Reader  repository.NextActionSnapshotReader
	Runtime PracticeExecutionReader
}

func snapshotHash(s domain.NextActionSnapshot) [32]byte {
	b, _ := json.Marshal(s)
	return sha256.Sum256(b)
}
func (u NextActionResolver) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentNextAction, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentNextAction{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if u.Reader == nil {
		return domain.StudentNextAction{}, errors.New("next action reader required")
	}
	s, err := u.Reader.ReadNextActionSnapshot(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentNextAction{}, err
	}
	if s.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.StudentNextAction{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
	}
	projections := map[string]domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{}
	for _, b := range s.Bindings {
		if !domain.RequiredNextActionBinding(s, b) || u.Runtime == nil {
			continue
		}
		p, e := u.Runtime.ReadExecutionProjection(ctx, studentID, b.TaskInstanceID)
		if e != nil {
			continue
		}
		if validExecutionProjection(p, b, studentID) {
			projections[b.TaskInstanceID] = p
		}
	}
	// Cross-owner observations are not one distributed transaction. Fence Student
	// changes during Runtime reads, report WAITING, and let callers read again.
	if len(s.Bindings) > 0 {
		latest, e := u.Reader.ReadNextActionSnapshot(ctx, studentID)
		if e != nil {
			return domain.StudentNextAction{}, e
		}
		if snapshotHash(s) != snapshotHash(latest) {
			result := domain.ResolveNextAction(latest, nil)
			result.Status = "WAITING"
			result.Primary = nil
			result.ReasonCode = "state_changed"
			return result, nil
		}
	}
	return domain.ResolveNextAction(s, projections), nil
}
func validExecutionProjection(p domain.PracticeExecutionProjection, b domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, studentID string) bool {
	if p.Schema != "practice-execution-projection.v1" || p.StudentID != studentID || b.StudentID != studentID || p.TaskInstanceID != b.TaskInstanceID || p.LearningActionID != b.LearningActionID || p.TaskRevisionID != b.TaskRevisionID || p.TaskRevisionDigest != b.TaskRevisionDigest || p.LearningPathID != b.LearningPathID || p.LearningPathItemID != b.LearningPathItemID || p.RequirementID != b.RequirementID || p.Version == "" || len(p.Version) > 128 || p.ReasonCode == "" || len(p.ReasonCode) > 128 || len(p.AvailableActions) > 8 {
		return false
	}
	for _, id := range []string{p.StepID, p.MilestoneID, p.SubmissionID} {
		if id != "" && !validStudentUUID(id) {
			return false
		}
	}
	if p.SubmissionScope != "" && p.SubmissionScope != "MILESTONE" && p.SubmissionScope != "FINAL" {
		return false
	}
	switch p.Status {
	case "READY":
		if !domain.IsPracticeProgressionAction(p.SuggestedAction) {
			return false
		}
	case "BLOCKED", "COMPLETED", "CANCELLED":
		if p.SuggestedAction != "" {
			return false
		}
	default:
		return false
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, a := range p.AvailableActions {
		if !domain.IsPracticeProgressionAction(a) || seen[a] {
			return false
		}
		seen[a] = true
	}
	if p.Status == "READY" && !seen[p.SuggestedAction] {
		return false
	}
	return true
}
